# Settings

Version 0.0.1 · Owners: [@benallfree](https://github.com/benallfree)

One API for the settings an app's admins change for its extensions: PITR's S3 bucket, Bulk Mail's sending settings,
and any extension that registers a section. The dashboard screens, the CLI and agents all use it.

[Install](#install) · [Configure](#configure) · [Use](#use) · [Integrations](#integrations) · [Example](#example)

## Install

Settings is built into `pocketone` and **on by default**; there's nothing to install. In your own Go build:

```go
extkit.Setup(app, []extkit.Extension{settings.New(), pitr.New(pitr.Config{})}, nil, nil)
```

The module is `github.com/pockethost/pocketone/ext/settings`.

## Configure

There's nothing to configure.

## Use

It provides the [settings/v1](https://pocketone.dev/docs/contracts/settings/v1) contract (superusers only):

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: $TOKEN" https://app.example.com/api/_c/settings/v1                      # which extensions
curl -H "Authorization: $TOKEN" "https://app.example.com/api/_c/settings/v1/get?extension=pitr" # one extension's
```

Agents get the same through MCP (`settings_list`, `settings_get`, `settings_save`, `settings_test`).

## Commands and APIs

Generated from the `pocketone` binary and the contracts this extension provides.

### [settings/v1](https://pocketone.dev/docs/contracts/settings/v1)

| Operation | CLI | REST | MCP |
|---|---|---|---|
| [list](https://pocketone.dev/docs/contracts/settings/v1#list) | `pocketone remote settings list` | `GET /api/_c/settings/v1` | `settings_list` |
| [get](https://pocketone.dev/docs/contracts/settings/v1#get) | `pocketone remote settings get --extension <value>` | `GET /api/_c/settings/v1/get` | `settings_get` |
| [save](https://pocketone.dev/docs/contracts/settings/v1#save) | `pocketone remote settings save --extension <value> --values <json>` | `POST /api/_c/settings/v1/save` | `settings_save` |
| [test](https://pocketone.dev/docs/contracts/settings/v1#test) | `pocketone remote settings test --extension <value> --values <json>` | `POST /api/_c/settings/v1/test` | `settings_test` |

## Integrations

| Extension | How they fit |
|---|---|
| [PITR](https://pocketone.dev/docs/extensions/pitr) | Its S3 destination is a section. |
| [Bulk Mail](https://pocketone.dev/docs/extensions/bulkmail) | Its sending settings are a section. |
| [Contracts](https://pocketone.dev/docs/contracts) | settings/v1 is the contract; a host could provide it instead. |

## Example

```go
// Command example is a PocketBase app with settings/v1: the standard extensions' admin settings (here pitr's) behind
// one API. `curl -H "Authorization: <superuser token>" http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/_c/settings/v1` lists them.
//
// Logins (ext/devusers, local testing only): dashboard admin@example.com / password.
package main

import (
	"log"

	"ganigeorgiev.com/pocketbase/pocketbase"
	"github.com/pockethost/pocketone/ext/devusers"
	"github.com/pockethost/pocketone/ext/extkit"
	"github.com/pockethost/pocketone/ext/pitr"
	"github.com/pockethost/pocketone/ext/settings"
)

func main() {
	app := pocketbase.New()
	devusers.Register(app) // local testing: superuser admin@example.com and user user@example.com, password "password"
	if _, err := extkit.Setup(app, []extkit.Extension{settings.New(), pitr.New(pitr.Config{})}, nil, nil); err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := app.Start(); err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
}
```
